quest.title: A Provisional Arrangement
quest.description: Something's wrong with the stairway at Wangshu Inn, and it's been closed for repairs. Getting up to the top is now a problem...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x4000

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: That should just about do it. What hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up with those stairs over there?

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: The stairs? Oh, you want to go up to the inn?

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: You've come at a bad time, there's two big holes on the way up. To prevent people from missing their step, the boss has had the whole stairway closed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: The preparations for repairs have been made, but the stairs won't be fit for walking for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: Don't worry. You can't use the stairs, but the elevator over there is just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: It can move cargo, so carrying people isn't a problem. If you're in a rush, how about using that instead?

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, and while you're at it, help me give this to the boss. It's a gift from a guest.

response.speaker: Zhen Qiang
response.text: Well, off you go, then. Remember to watch your footing. This inn is pretty high up, so falling off halfway is no joke!

choices.text: Why aren't you going up yourself?

response.speaker: Zhen Qiang
response.text: I need to stay down here to receive goods. There's lot of goods to receive, and I daren't make any mistakes.

response.speaker: Zhen Qiang
response.text: Alright, off you get. Watch your footing, now. This inn is pretty high up, and falling off halfway is no joke!

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: We've got to repair those stairs quickly...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I am. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Some guy downstairs asked us to give this package to you.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Oh, this must be a package that a guest sent to me. Why didn't Zhen Qiang bring it up himself?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Still had goods to pick up, did he? Ha, I bet he was just too lazy to go up and down the elevator...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I'm really sorry. You're a guest of ours, and the stairs just had to be broken at this time. I'm finding a way to fix it as we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: And to think that we made you take the trouble to bring this package up for me. Here, take this as a token of my appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: This was originally for Zhen Qiang, but since he made you deliver the package for him, then the pay is yours by right.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Well then, I must be going to get the preparations for repairs going. Feel free to have a look around the inn. If there's anything you need, you can look for me at any time.
